description: Blocks a profile session from writing into the engine or the installed plugin cache (scripts/guard_engine_writes.py, docs/adr-010-engine-write-guard.md), DENYs a ref-based click that resolves to an outbound-terminal control such as Send/Connect/Invite/Apply (scripts/guard_outbound_click.py, docs/deployment.md's 'outbound-click guard' section), DENYs the gmail-multi connector's send/reply/forward tools so jobsearch stays draft-only now that the connector can send (scripts/guard_mail_send.py, marketplace #213), DENYs a gmail-multi mailbox read/draft call whose account is not exactly one of this profile's own addresses — the connector's config is machine-wide and would otherwise return another profile's mail (scripts/guard_mail_scope.py, design-manifest-heal.md § The boundary — fails OPEN with a queryable diag row when tool_input is not visible to this build at all), records that a SessionStart hook fired before any model turn so a run that dies before it can call journal.py --start still leaves proof a session existed (scripts/journal.py --fired, the 'fired' event, public #65 — loud on failure, exit 0 on every path; the hooks in this SessionStart group run in parallel, not in sequence, so this is one of several rather than a guaranteed first), runs the engine-purity term scan against this machine's own real profile as the last envelope of migrate.py --hook (scripts/check_engine_purity.hook_step(), dev #411 — loud on a real hit via an asks.jsonl row, exit 0 on every path, 30s timeout), and self-installs the connector plugins declared in plugin.json metadata.connectors at session start (scripts/ensure_connectors.py — loud on failure, exit 0 on every path).
